attempts.hypothesis: Instruction count should be approximately fixed setup cost plus per-step cost and per-step text-token cost, since this workload supplies embeddings directly and returns latents without VAE decoding.

pcvs.name: denoising_steps
pcvs.rationale: Each step repeats two transformer calls, classifier-free guidance, and a scheduler update; latent dimensions and model configuration are fixed in this workload.

pcvs.name: step_text_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Text projection and cross-attention work scale with the supplied embedding sequence length on every denoising step.

attempts.hypothesis: The substantial unexplained work across repeated identical input shapes suggests runtime initialization effects. Loaded-module cardinality and its interaction with step count may distinguish these regimes while retaining the main workload scaling terms.

pcvs.name: denoising_steps
pcvs.rationale: Captures repeated transformer and scheduler work.

pcvs.name: step_text_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures sequence-length-dependent work within each denoising step.

pcvs.name: loaded_modules
pcvs.rationale: Cheap runtime-state cardinality that may distinguish library initialization regimes across repeated pipeline runs.

pcvs.name: steps_loaded_modules
pcvs.rationale: Allows per-step instruction cost to vary with the observable library initialization regime.
